biggest.title: Walmart Recalls Over 4.4 Million Expert Grill Brushes Due to Ingestion Hazard
biggest.imageCaption: Expert Grill 16-inch Steel Fiber Scrub Brush and Scraper for Grills
biggest.retailerText:
Sold At:
Walmart and online, including Walmart.com from January 2021 through August 2026 for between $1 and $28.
biggest.hazard: Small metal wire bristles can detach from the brushes and stick to the grill or food, posing an ingestion hazard and risk of serious internal injuries that could require surgery.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled grill brushes immediately and contact Walmart for a full refund or a credit for use at any Walmart store or Walmart.com. Consumers will be asked to return their recalled brushes to Walmart or discard them.

biggest.title: Conair Expands Recall of Cuisinart Grill Brushes Due to Ingestion Hazard; Over 3.6 Million Brushes Now Recalled
biggest.unitsRaw: About 1,905,805 additional brushes (Conair previously recalled 1,719,995 grill brushes in July 2026 for a total of 3,625,800)
biggest.retailerText:
Sold At:
Walmart, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Ross and online including Amazon and Cuisinart.com from June 2009 through March 2026 for between $8 and $20.
biggest.hazard: Small metal wire bristles can detach from the brushes and stick to the grill or food, posing an ingestion hazard and risk of serious internal injuries that could require surgery.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled grill brushes immediately and contact Conair for a full refund or a credit for use at Cuisinart.com for a full refund plus 20% of the cash refund amount. Consumers will be asked to discard the recalled grill brushes.

biggest.title: Louisville Ladder Recalls Over One Million Attic Stairway Ladders Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard
biggest.product: Louisville, Featherlite, Lite & Century Attic Stairway Ladders with gas struts
biggest.unitsRaw: 1,770,000 (In addition, about 13,054 were sold in Canada)
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Attic Stairway Ladder with gas struts (Location of Brand Marking)
biggest.retailerText: The Home Depot, Lowe's, Do It Best, Orgill, and other retailers nationwide and on-line at Amazon.com from November 2012 through July 2026 for between $170 and $600.
biggest.hazard: The bolts on the attic stairway ladders can break while in use, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fall hazard.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled ladders immediately and register at Atticstairwayrecall.expertinquiry.com to receive a free repair kit. Consumers should have the ladder's model number, which can be found on the inside of the attic door, available when they register. If your unit is included in the recall, the firm will send a free repair kit containing two replacement ¼" spreader bolts, washers, and lock nuts with installation instructions.

biggest.title: Conair Recalls Over One Million Cuisinart Grill Brushes Due to Ingestion Hazard
biggest.retailerText: Burlington, TJ Maxx and Ross stores and online including Amazon.com and Cuisinart.com from June 2009 through March 2026 for between $8 and $20.
biggest.hazard: Small metal wire bristles can detach from the brushes and stick to the grill or food, posing an ingestion hazard and risk of serious internal injuries that could require surgery.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled grill brushes immediately and contact Conair for a full refund or a credit for use at Cuisinart.com for a full refund plus 20% of the cash refund amount. Consumers will be asked to discard the recalled grill brushes.

biggest.title: Thrasio Recalls Angry Orange Enzyme Stain Removers Due to Risk of Exposure to Bacteria
biggest.unitsRaw: About 1,500,000 (In addition, about 43,700 were sold in Canada)
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Orange Twist Angry Orange Enzyme Stain Remover
biggest.retailerText: Walmart, Target, The Home Depot, Meijer, Staples, TJ Maxx and other major retailers nationwide and online at Amazon.com, Walmart.com, Target.com, AngryOrange.com and Chewy.com from March 2019 through December 2025 for between $4 and $60.
biggest.hazard: The recalled products can contain bacteria, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa, an environmental organism found widely in soil and water. People with weakened immune systems, external medical devices, or underlying lung conditions who are exposed to Pseudomonas aeruginosa face a risk of serious infection that may require medical treatment. The bacteria can enter the body if inhaled, through the eyes, or through a break in the skin. People with healthy immune systems are usually not affected by bacteria.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled Angry Orange Enzyme Stain Remover products and contact Thrasio for a full refund. To receive a refund, consumers should take a picture of the product with "recalled" and their initials written on it in marker and email the photo to productrecall@angryorange.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product in its container with household trash. Do not empty the product prior to disposal. Do not attempt to recycle the product bottle.

biggest.title: Bayer Recalls 6 mL Size Afrin Original Nasal Spray Bottles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Illness from Child Poisoning; Violates Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging
biggest.product: Travel Size Afrin® Original Nasal Spray 6 mL Bottles
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Afrin® 6mL Size Original Nasal Spray Bottles (Front of Bottle)
biggest.retailerText: Retailers such as convenience stores and travel hubs including airports from September 2024 to April 2026 for about $7 to $9.
biggest.hazard: The 6 mL nasal sprays contain an imidazoline, which must be in child-resistant packaging or meet the labeling requirements for non-complying packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The 6 mL nasal spray's packaging is not child-resistant nor bears the required labeling statement, posing a risk of serious injury or illness from poisoning, if the contents are swallowed by young children.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should immediately secure the recalled bottles out of sight and reach of children and go to the webform posted on www.livewell.bayer.com/afrin-original-spray-recall to begin a request for a refund. Consumers will be asked to take and submit a photo of the product before disposing of it in order to receive a refund.

biggest.title: E Mishan Recalls Granitestone Diamond Pro Blue Stainless Sauté Pans Due to Impact and Burn Hazards
biggest.product: Granitestone Diamond Pro Blue Sauté Pans
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Granitestone Diamond Pro Blue Stainless 10” & 11.5” Sauté Pans
biggest.retailerText: The recalled sauté pans were sold in stores at Costco and online at Costco.com, Walmart.com, and Amazon.com from August 2021 through February 2026 for about $40.
biggest.hazard: The metal cap on the screw that connects the sauté pan to the handle can become detached and forcefully eject when heated, posing impact and burn hazards to consumers.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled sauté pans immediately and contact E Mishan for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to return the recalled sauté pan.

biggest.title: Wagner Spray Tech Recalls 900 Series Power Steamers Due to Burn Hazard
biggest.imageCaption: Recalled Wagner Model 905e Auto Steamer, pictured with included accessories
biggest.retailerText: The Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Target, HSN and QVC, and online at Amazon.com and www.wagnerspraytech.com from November 2018 to March 2026 for between $130 and $200.
biggest.hazard: The attached hose can get excessively hot and the nozzle/gun can expel hot water during use and after the trigger is engaged, posing a serious burn hazard to consumers.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled steamers immediately and contact Wagner for a free repair kit, consisting of a hose sleeve, nozzle cover and funnel.

biggest.title: Dupray USA Recalls Neat Steam Cleaners Due to Risk of Burn Hazards or Serious Injury
biggest.unitsRaw: About 651,145 (In addition, about 96,530 were sold in Canada)
biggest.retailerText: Online at dupray.com and in stores and online at Home Depot, Lowe's, Macy's, Walmart, Amazon.com and other retailers nationwide from April 2018 through December 2025 for about $150.
biggest.hazard: The steam cleaner's boiler can rupture if it is overfilled, corroded and the pressure release valve malfunctions, posing risk of burn hazards or serious injury to users or bystanders.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled steam cleaner immediately and go to dupray.com for instructions on receiving a free replacement safety boiler cap. Consumers will need their batch code, which is found on the bottom of the cleaner, to determine eligibility for the recall. The new safety cap is quick and easy to install with a simple screw-on design.

biggest.title: Greenworks Tools Recalls 24V and 48V Kobalt Yard Power Tools with USB-C Batteries Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire Hazard
biggest.product: Kobalt 24V and 48V Trimmers, Blowers, Mowers, Chainsaws and Pruning Saws with USB-C Batteries
biggest.retailerText: Lowe's stores nationwide and online at Lowes.com from January 2026 through May 2026 for between $20 and $482.
biggest.hazard: Charging the lithium-ion batteries through the USB-C port, while the batteries are inserted in the yard power tools can cause the batteries to short-circuit, posing a risk of serious injury from fire hazard.
biggest.remedy: Consumers should stop charging the batteries with the USB-C port while the batteries are inserted in the yard power tools immediately and contact Greenworks Tools to receive a free replacement battery. Consumers will be asked to complete the registration form at https://www.greenworkstools.com/pages/kobalt-product-recall to receive replacement batteries without the USB-C port, a charger adapter, a warning label to affix on the yard power tool, an updated product manual and a pre-paid shipping label along with instructions for returning the recalled batteries.

recent.title: Decathlon America Recalls Van Rysel GRVL AF Bicycles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard
recent.imageCaption: Recalled USA Van Rysel GRVL AF Sword Brown CN FR (model number 8911304)
recent.retailerText:
Sold At:
REI Co-op stores nationwide and online at REI.com from March 2025 through August 2026 for between $1,400 and $2,300.
recent.hazard: The recalled bicycles’ front lock nut can loosen during use, causing the front wheel to dislodge or loosen over time, posing a crash hazard.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and take them to the nearest Recreational Equipment (REI Co-op) location for a free inspection and repair service of the front fork assembly. Anyone unable to visit an REI Co-op location can contact Decathlon Customer Service directly for assistance. Recalled models can be identified by the Van Rysel Product ID on the top right of the product label under the frame, beginning with the number 5.

recent.title: DR Power Equipment Recalls Pilot and Premier Trimmer Mowers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards
recent.product: DR Power Equipment Pilot and Premier Trimmer Mowers
recent.unitsRaw: About 42,860 (In addition, about 340 were sold in Canada)
recent.imageCaption: Recalled DR Power Pilot Trimmer Mower - model T4X1076DMN
recent.retailerText:
Sold At:
Ace, TSC, Bomgaars, other home improvement, hardware and independent power equipment stores nationwide and online at drpower.com from November 2022 through July 2026 for between $380 to $550.
recent.hazard: Grass and debris can accumulate in the trimmer mowers and ignite, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire and burn hazards.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled trimmer mowers immediately and contact DR Power Equipment for a free repair kit. If consumers have concerns about installing the repair kit, contact DR Power Equipment to schedule a free repair installation from an authorized dealer.

recent.title: Giant Bicycle Recalls LED-Light Keys Included with SureLock Bike Lock Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violates Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
recent.retailerText:
Sold At:
Giant Bicycle authorized stores nationwide and online at https://www.giant-bicycles.com/us from March 2023 through August 2026 for between $25 and $65.
recent.hazard: The LED-light key that was included with certain SureLock Bicycle Lock sets violates the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the packaging and product do not have the warnings required under Reese’s Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns, and death.
recent.remedy:
Consumers should stop using the recalled LED-light key that was included with certain SureLock Bicycle Lock sets immediately and contact Giant Bicycle for a $5 refund. Consumers will be asked to bring the LED key to an authorized Giant retailer to participate in the recall and receive the refund. When returning the LED-light key to a retailer, consumers will be required to bring either the complete bicycle lock purchase or a picture of the serial number on the bicycle lock in order to verify the serial number is in the scope of the recall. Consumers may continue to use the bicycle lock and non-LED-light keys included with the SureLock Bicycle Lock sets.  


Note: Button and Coin cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

recent.title: ONTHEWEI Recalls Baby Bath Seats Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Children from Drowning; Violate Mandatory Standard for Infant Bath Seats
recent.retailerText:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com in April 2026 for between $40 and $50.
recent.hazard: The recalled bath seats violate the mandatory standard for infant bath seats because they are unstable and can tip over while in use, posing a risk of serious injury or death due to drowning.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bath seats immediately and contact ONTHEWEI for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the bath seat by writing in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the front of the bath seat, disassembling it by removing the back rest and arm restraints and cutting the three suction cups on the seat’s underside and send a photo of the destroyed bath seat showing the marked product to onthewei@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

recent.title: Pacearth Direct Recalls PACEARTH Swing Seats Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
recent.retailerText:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from May 2017 through June 2026 for between $27 and $57.
recent.hazard: The seats, metal carabiners or quick links, or webbing straps of the recalled swing seats can break during use, posing a risk of serious injury due to fall hazard.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled swing seats immediately and contact Pacearth Direct for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the swing seat with permanent marker, take a photo of it, including the PACEARTH logo and email to recall@pacearth.com.

recent.title: Romorgniz Recalls Six-Drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
recent.retailerText:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from May 2025 through August 2026 for between $100 and $170.
recent.hazard: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standards as required by the STURDY Act.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact Romorgniz for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the top, front and sides of the dresser, remove all drawers and send photos of the marked and disassembled dresser to Romorgnizrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product.

recent.title: Snow Peak Recalls Propane Fireplace Inserts and Lava Rocks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn and Fire Hazards
recent.product: Snow Peak Takibi Fireplace Propane Inserts and Lava Rocks
recent.imageCaption: Recalled Takibi Propane Insert (model ST-332-US) with reddish brown lava rocks inside the Snow Peak’s Pack & Carry Fireplace
recent.retailerText:
Sold Online At:
Snowpeak.com from July 2026 through July 2026 for about $350.
recent.hazard: The fireplace’s lava rocks can ignite and explode when heated in the propane insert, posing a risk of serious injury or death from burn and fire hazards.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the propane insert and lava rocks fireplace accessories immediately and contact Snow Peak for a full refund. Consumers will be provided with a prepaid shipping label to return the propane insert and lava rocks. For replacement lava rocks only, the consumer can keep the propane inserts, and the firm will ship replacement lava rocks to the consumer. Do not use inserts until replacement lava rocks are received. Consumers should dispose of the recalled lava rocks in accordance with any local and state ordinances.

recent.title: The Conqueror Recalls Avengers Medals Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Magnets
recent.imageCaption: Recalled Avengers Infinity Gauntlet Medal showing faulty magnet
recent.retailerText:
Sold Online At:
www.theconqueror.events and through The Conqueror App from March 2026 through May 2026 for about $50.
recent.hazard: The recalled medals violate the mandatory safety standard for magnets because the high-powered magnets may detach, posing a deadly ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other or other metal objects and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Avengers Infinity Gauntlet Medal immediately and contact The Conqueror for instructions on receiving a full refund or a replacement medal. Consumers will be asked to cut the ribbon from the medal and write “RECALLED” in permanent marker on the medal and ribbon, throw the product away and email a photo of the disposed medal and ribbon to support@theconqueror.events.

recent.title: ABC Trading Recalls Squishy Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Water Bead Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
recent.product: Squishy Dumpling Toys, Crazy Squib Ball Toys
recent.retailerText:
Sold At:
ABC Trading stores in Los Angeles, California and other stores nationwide from April 2026 through June 2026 for between 41 cents and $1.25.
recent.hazard: The squishy toys violate the mandatory safety standard for toys because the water beads inside the toys expand larger than permitted, posing a deadly ingestion hazard. If a water bead is ingested, it can pose ingestion, choking, and intestinal obstruction hazards inside a child's body, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and a risk of death to a child.
recent.remedy: Consumers should stop using the squishy toys immediately and contact ABC Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" in permanent marker on the squishy toys, throw the toy away and email a photo of the disposed toy to recallabc@gmail.com.

recent.title: Agrish Reannounces and Expands Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Additional Units Added
recent.product: Agrish Adult Portable Bed Rails, models 12014, AG-12011 and 12016
recent.unitsRaw: About 35,083 units (About 5,000 of these bed rails were previously recalled in January 2026)
recent.imageCaption: Recalled Agrish Adult Portable Bed Rail Model Number 12014
recent.retailerText:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from April 2025 through May 2026 for between $50 and $80.
recent.hazard: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because when the bed rails are attached to a bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. The bed rails do not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing a fall hazard. Additionally, the bed rails’ push pins and push pin holes are incorrectly sized, posing a laceration hazard.
recent.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled adult portable bed rails and contact Agrish Direct for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to go to http://www.agrish.online/recall to register for the recall and receive instructions on how to dispose of the recalled bed rail.
